newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein easier in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein easier in thin trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were easier in late trading on Wednesday, with buyers staying sidelined amid falls in Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein was mostly quoted at 1,350 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, compared with 1,350-55 rupiah at the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,345 rupiah.
"The market remains weak," one trader said. "Demand has been thin, with buyers mostly taking a wait and see position because of the falls in Malaysia throughout the day."
"Sentiment is bearish and some players are offering at below the market range," he added.
The traders said the prospects of a price recovery this week after four straight weeks of decline seemed dim in the wake of sustained poor demand and declines in Malaysia.
"There is little chance of a rebound coming this week," one trader said. "The market is also under pressure from sharp declines in Chicago soyoil prices."
Chicago soyoil futures fell sharply for the second day on Tuesday in spillover liquidation to higher than expected soybean plantings announced by the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
